name: Clover (Closed-Loop Verifiable Code Generation)
one_liner: Checks mutual consistency between code, docstrings, and formal Dafny specifications using SMT equivalence and deductive verification.

loop.proposes: An LLM generates Dafny implementation code, formal preconditions/postconditions, and loop invariants from a problem description.
loop.judged_by: The Dafny/Boogie/Z3 verifier checks that the code satisfies the specification and tests logical equivalence between reconstructed specs and test suites.
loop.steers: Z3 verification errors and equivalence counterexamples are returned to the LLM to repair either the implementation or the annotations.

headline_result: Accepted 87% of correct Dafny programs while rejecting all of adversarial incorrect synthesis candidates on the CloverBench suite.
caveat: Of the six checks, the Dafny verifier checks the code against its annotations and five reconstruction tests each use an LLM.
beyond_harness_note: The Dafny/Z3 SMT verifier checks deductive correctness and specification equivalence across the synthesis loop.
generative_model: GPT-4 Dafny code and specification generator
algorithmic_authority: Dafny compiler and Z3 SMT solver

sources.title: Clover: Closed-Loop Verifiable Code Generation (arXiv:2310.17807, first posted 2023-10-26)

verification.notes: Checked against Sun et al., arXiv:2310.17807. Year corrected 2024 to 2023 (first posting); SAIV 2024 venue is not printed on the arXiv page, so it was removed from the source title (ledger).
